matched_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai Motor India to invest Rs 11,000 crore at Pune plant'이다. Hyundai Motor India announced plans to invest Rs 11,000 crore at its Pune facility in phases. This investment aims to expand manufacturing capacity and enhance industrial development in the region. The Pune plant currently has an annual capacity of 170,000 units, which will increase to 320,000 by 2030. This investment follows Hyundai's earlier commitment of $15. 5 billion for a comprehensive strategy over seven years. matched_articles.summary: Nexon 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Nexon Geochem to set up ₹1,250-crore rare-earth permanent magnet facility in Andhra Pradesh'이다. The facility would feature annual production capacity of 600 tonnes of high-grade permanent magnets, serving the rapidly growing electric vehicle (EV), renewable energy and advanced manufacturing sectors. com/companies/nexon-geochem-to-set-up-1250-crore-rare-earth-permanent-magnet-facility-in-andhra-pradesh/article71582826 ece Rare-earth magnet (Image for representation) Advanced materials company Nexon Geochem on Wednesday said a rare-earth permanent magnet facility will be set up in Andhra Pradesh with an investment of ₹1,250 crore As the driving force and primary investor behind this project, Nexon Geochem is committing a total investment of ₹1,250 crore across two strategic phases — ₹750 crore dedicated to the first phase and ₹500 crore allocated for the second phase “Nexon Geochem today announced the signing of a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to establish an integrated sintered NdFeB rare-earth permanent magnet manufacturing facility in Thondangi, Kakinada district,” the statement said “Our vision is to establish an integrated NdFeB magnet manufacturing ecosystem that strengthens supply-chain security, reduces import dependence, and supports India’s ambitions in electric mobility, renewable energy and advanced manufacturing,” Praveen Kumar Choudhary, Director, Nexon Geochem Pvt Ltd, said. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
